Name: Kemei
description: The Kemei KM-2600 trimmer features stainless steel blades, a 0.25–9 mm trimming range, 120-minute battery life, and both corded and cordless use. Designed for beards and moustaches, it's ideal for men seeking reliable grooming at a budget price.

Name: BabylissPRO
description: The BabylissPRO FXONE trimmer runs up to 3 hours on an interchangeable lithium battery and features a brushless motor, metal housing, and 7200 RPM deep-tooth T-blade. Built for barbers, it's perfect for high-precision styling and long-lasting performance.

Name: Gillette
description: The Gillette Style Master is a cordless, waterproof trimmer with 4D blades and three combs for trimming in multiple directions. With a 45-minute battery life, pivoting head, and replaceable metal blade, it's great for flexible, close grooming.

Name: Bevel
description: The Bevel Trimmer offers tool-free zero-gap adjustments, non-slip grip, and a blade designed to repel oil and dirt for less irritation. Its ergonomic build and thumb-turn blade dial make it a favorite for precise fades and daily use.

Name: Andis
description: The Andis Master Cordless Clipper delivers over 90 minutes of runtime with carbon-steel blades adjustable from 000 to 1 and a powerful magnetic motor. Designed for professional precision and durability with a sleek aluminum body.

Name: Remington
description: The Remington Crafter Beard Boss kit offers 180 minutes of cordless runtime, waterproof design, turbo mode, and multiple accessories for trimming goatees, mustaches, and more—ideal for detailed, long-lasting grooming control.
